gaps.title: Incident detection tailored to Peruvian serenazgo contexts
gaps.why_now: Municipalities increase security budgets but generic analytics miss local crime patterns, causing operator fatigue and slow response.
gaps.evidence_needed: Interview serenazgo operators at 3 municipalities to catalog undetected incident types; prototype a detection model on sample footage and compare to manual monitoring.
gaps.risk: Competitors may adapt with localized models; requires continuous data collection.

gaps.title: Software-only AI overlay that works with existing camera infrastructure
gaps.why_now: PIM budgets favor opex over capex; municipalities have large deployed bases of basic cameras they cannot replace.
gaps.evidence_needed: Test compatibility with top 3 camera models in Peru (Hikvision, Dahua, generic RTSP) and measure integration effort; survey procurement officers on opex vs capex preference.
gaps.risk: Camera vendors may improve edge lock-in or restrict API access; requires robust video ingestion.

gaps.title: Simple, operator-friendly interface for non-technical serenazgo staff
gaps.why_now: High cognitive load leads to missed incidents; growing awareness of human-factors in control rooms.
gaps.evidence_needed: Run usability tests with 5 operators comparing existing interfaces; measure alert response time and error rate.
gaps.risk: UX is easy to copy; not a standalone moat.

gaps.title: End-to-end integration with municipal dispatching and incident management
gaps.why_now: Fragmented response processes delay action; municipalities seek unified command solutions.
gaps.evidence_needed: Map current incident response workflow in one municipality; quantify time loss from detection to dispatch.
gaps.risk: Requires partnerships with dispatch system vendors; internal resistance to change.

gaps.title: Annual license model aligned with PIM budget structure
gaps.why_now: Municipal procurement processes are slow and capex-heavy; SaaS matches operational spending cycles.
gaps.evidence_needed: Analyze PIM execution reports for security camera projects; interview finance officers about willingness to pay annually.
gaps.risk: SaaS alone is not a strong differentiator; competitors may adopt it.

gaps.title: Local language, documentation, and in-country technical support
gaps.why_now: Municipalities demand quick issue resolution; distrust of foreign-only support.
gaps.evidence_needed: Interview municipal IT staff about support pain points; measure downtime costs and response times of current vendors.
gaps.risk: Local integrators could replicate support structures; not a tech moat.

checkpoint_instruction: Validate pain and urgency of tailored incident detection by conducting on-site observations and interviews with serenazgo operators in two municipalities, and running a pilot of a prototype detection model on their camera feeds.
